features.title: Vitest 安装配置 + 首个 unit test 跑通
features.acceptance: 安装 vitest + @vitest/coverage-v8 + @vitest/ui + jsdom + @testing-library/react + @testing-library/jest-dom + @testing-library/user-event；vitest.config.ts 配置 jsdom + setupFiles + coverage 80% 阈值；tests/setup.ts 含 @testing-library/jest-dom matchers；package.json 加 scripts: test / test:unit / test:watch / test:coverage / test:ui；占位 unit test src/lib/__tests__/utils.test.ts 测 cn() 函数；npm run test:unit 跑通占位 + npm run test:coverage 输出报告到 coverage/ + npm run test:ui 起 Vitest UI

features.title: Testcontainers PostgreSQL helper + 首个 integration test
features.acceptance: 安装 testcontainers + @testcontainers/postgresql；tests/helpers/db.ts 提供 setupTestDb/teardownTestDb/withTestTenant/cleanDb helpers；tests/integration/db-setup.test.ts 占位测试启动 PG 容器 + migrate + 简单 CRUD；npm run test:integration 跑通；多测试并行用唯一 DB 名无冲突；beforeAll 共享容器（启动 ~10s 可接受）

features.title: Playwright 安装 + 浏览器 + 配置 + 首个 E2E test
features.acceptance: 安装 @playwright/test + npx playwright install --with-deps chromium；playwright.config.ts 配置 testDir ./tests/e2e + baseURL localhost:3000 + screenshot only-on-failure + trace retain-on-failure + viewport 1440x900 + webServer auto-start；scripts: test:e2e / test:e2e:ui / test:e2e:debug；占位 E2E tests/e2e/landing.spec.ts 访问 / 看到 KOLMatrix 文字；npm run test:e2e 启动 dev 跑测试关闭；失败时 playwright-report/ 含截图

features.title: MSW 配置 + aigcgateway / Resend mock 框架
features.acceptance: 安装 msw 2.x；tests/mocks/handlers.ts 含 aigcgateway POST /v1/evaluate 默认 mock score + Resend POST /emails 默认 mock message ID；tests/mocks/server.ts Node 端 setupServer + tests/mocks/browser.ts 浏览器端 setupWorker；tests/setup.ts 集成 server.listen/resetHandlers/close 生命周期；示例 test tests/__example/msw-usage.test.ts 展示 handler override 模拟 500 错误

features.title: Test fixtures（faker factory 函数）
features.acceptance: 安装 @faker-js/faker；tests/fixtures/{tenant,user,kol,campaign}.ts 各自 make* factory 函数接受 overrides 返回完整对象；tests/fixtures/index.ts barrel export；工厂生成的对象可直接 prisma.kol.create({ data: makeKol() }) 入库；random data 不触发 DB 约束；每个工厂含文件头注释说明字段语义

features.title: B0 代码 unit tests（lib + 12 公共组件覆盖）
features.acceptance: src/lib/__tests__/db.test.ts 测 withTenant 包装行为（mocked Prisma）；src/lib/__tests__/utils.test.ts 测 cn 等 utils；src/components/layout/__tests__/Sidebar.test.tsx + Topbar.test.tsx 含渲染 + 激活态切换；src/components/common/__tests__/ 下 12 组件每个 ≥2 test case（基础渲染 + 关键 props）；npm run test:unit -- src/lib 覆盖率 ≥80%；npm run test:unit -- src/components 覆盖率 ≥80%

features.title: B0 RLS + Auth integration tests
features.acceptance: tests/integration/rls-isolation.test.ts 覆盖 6 张多租户表（user/kol/campaign/kol_campaign/email_template/email_log）cross-tenant 查询返回 0 + 不带上下文 raw 查询返回 0；tests/integration/auth-flow.test.ts 测 CredentialsProvider 登录成功 JWT 含 tenantId/role + 错误密码 401 + JWT 解码恢复 session；tests/integration/middleware.test.ts 未登录 /dashboard 重定向 /login + 登录后通过；全部通过

features.title: Marketer 登录 + Dashboard E2E flow test
features.acceptance: tests/e2e/marketer-dashboard.spec.ts 4 test case：访问 /login 输入 marketer@kolmatrix.local/KOLM@2026! 跳 /dashboard；dashboard 看到 Welcome back Sarah + 12,847 总 KOL 数；切换语言 EN→ZH nav 文案变化；点 sidebar nav 跳路由（如 KOL Database 链接 → /kols）；失败自动截图 + trace；npm run test:e2e 全绿

features.title: 视觉回归基线 + Dashboard 截图对比
features.acceptance: tests/e2e/visual-regression.spec.ts 含 /dashboard toHaveScreenshot('dashboard.png', { threshold: 0.02, maxDiffPixels: 1000 })；首次 --update-snapshots 创建 baseline 存 tests/screenshots/baseline/ 并 commit 入库；后续跑测试 dashboard 截图与 baseline diff < 2%；故意改 Dashboard CSS 触发 diff 测试失败 + 生成 diff 图

features.title: CI workflow 集成 4 个新 jobs
features.acceptance: .github/workflows/ci.yml 在原有 lint+tsc+build 基础上加 unit-tests job (coverage + Codecov 上传) + integration-tests job (PG + Redis service container) + e2e-tests job (playwright install chromium + webServer + 失败上传 playwright-report artifact)；tests/screenshots/baseline/ 入库；tests/screenshots/actual/ + diff/ + playwright-report/ 入 .gitignore；CODECOV_TOKEN secret 由用户配置；PR 触发 4 jobs 全绿；故意 break test CI fail
